statement: The recorded payment destination is not safe or correct to use because the account holder does not match the employee and the account-change dates conflict, so I will place the payment on hold.
judge_text:
WRONG

"The recorded payment destination is not safe or correct to use because the account holder does not match the employee and the account-change dates conflict" — asserts the record value is wrong and names the problem.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
